description: A single icon within an EmailSocialBlock (mj-social-element).

members.name: Alt
members.description: Gets or sets the icon alternative text (alt).

members.name: BackgroundColor
members.description: Gets or sets the background colour override (background-color).

members.name: Href
members.description: Gets or sets the link target (href).

members.name: Label
members.description: Gets or sets the optional label text shown next to the icon.

members.name: Name
members.description: Gets or sets the network name mapping to a built-in icon (name).

members.name: Src
members.description: Gets or sets a custom icon URL overriding Name (src).

members.name: Target
members.description: Gets or sets the link target window (target).
